setup.en: Use a flat bench and light dumbbells, lighter than you would press: with the arms wide, the weights are far from the shoulder.
setup.zh: 用平板凳和较轻的哑铃，比卧推用的轻：手臂张开时，重量离肩关节很远。

steps.en: Lie back with the dumbbells, head, upper back and buttocks on the bench. Hold them above your chest, palms facing each other.
steps.zh: 带着哑铃躺下，头、上背和臀部贴住凳面。把哑铃举在胸口上方，掌心相对。

steps.en: Bend your elbows slightly and keep that same bend all the way.
steps.zh: 两肘微屈，整个过程保持这个角度不变。

steps.en: Breathe in and open your arms in a wide arc, slowly, until your upper arms are about level with your body.
steps.zh: 吸气，手臂沿一条宽弧线慢慢张开，直到上臂大约与身体齐平。

steps.en: Breathe out and bring the dumbbells back up along the same arc until they are above your chest, without knocking them together.
steps.zh: 呼气，沿同一条弧线把哑铃收回到胸口上方，不要让它们相撞。

steps.en: To finish, bend your elbows, bring the weights to your chest and sit up with them.
steps.zh: 结束时屈肘，把哑铃收到胸前，带着它们坐起。

cues.en: Hug a big tree: the upper arms move, the elbow angle does not.
cues.zh: 像抱一棵大树：动的是上臂，肘的角度不变。

cues.en: Feel a stretch across the chest, not a pinch in the shoulder.
cues.zh: 感到的是胸前的拉伸，不是肩部的夹痛。

mistakes.en: Straightening the elbows. Why: the longer lever loads the shoulder and elbow much more.
mistakes.zh: 把肘伸直。为什么：力臂变长，肩和肘受的力大很多。

mistakes.en: Lowering the arms below the body. Why: the shoulder is stretched further than you can control.
mistakes.zh: 手臂放得比身体还低。为什么：肩部被拉到超出你能控制的范围。

text.en: Start light enough that every repetition follows the same smooth path; add load or repetitions in small steps only once that feels easy.
text.zh: 起始重量要轻到每一次都能走同一条平稳的路线；等它变得轻松了，再小步增加重量或次数。

text.en: Light and heavy loads both build muscle when the sets are hard; heavier loads build more maximal strength.
text.zh: 只要每组都练得够吃力，轻重量和大重量都能增肌；大重量更能提高最大力量。

text.en: Spreading chest work over more than one day a week tends to work better than one big session.
text.zh: 把胸部训练分散到一周里不止一天，通常比一次练完效果好。

cautions.en: Stop if the front of the shoulder hurts; a press may suit you better.
cautions.zh: 肩前部疼痛就停下；卧推类动作可能更适合你。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Set both pulleys high, above shoulder height, with a single handle on each. Choose a light weight and stand in the middle with room to move.
setup.zh: 把两侧滑轮调到高于肩膀的位置，各挂一个单手把手。选较轻的重量，站在中间，留出活动空间。

steps.en: Take a handle in each hand and step forward into a split stance until the cables pull gently. Arms are out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.
steps.zh: 双手各握一个把手，向前迈一步成前后脚站立，直到绳索轻轻拉住手臂。手臂向两侧张开，肘微屈。

steps.en: Keep your ribs over your hips and your neck relaxed.
steps.zh: 肋骨在髋部正上方，脖子放松。

steps.en: Breathe out and sweep both arms down and in, in an arc, until your hands meet in front of your lower chest.
steps.zh: 呼气，双臂沿弧线向下、向内扫，直到双手在下胸前方会合。

steps.en: Breathe in and let the arms open slowly along the same arc, stopping before the cables pull your shoulders back too far.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿同一条弧线慢慢张开手臂，在绳索把肩膀拉得太靠后之前停下。

steps.en: To finish, bring the handles together and step back until the weights rest, then let go.
steps.zh: 结束时双手并拢，向后退直到配重落稳，再松手。

cues.en: Sweep the upper arms; the hands follow.
cues.zh: 扫动的是上臂，手只是跟着走。

cues.en: Stand still: only the arms move.
cues.zh: 身体站稳：只有手臂在动。

mistakes.en: Swinging the body forward to bring the handles together. Why: momentum does the work and the return snaps back.
mistakes.zh: 身体前冲把把手合拢。为什么：靠惯性完成动作，回程时会被猛地拉回去。

mistakes.en: Straightening and bending the elbows each repetition. Why: it becomes a press, not a fly.
mistakes.zh: 每次都伸肘屈肘。为什么：那就变成推，而不是夹胸了。

text.en: Start light enough that every repetition follows the same smooth path; add load or repetitions in small steps only once that feels easy.
text.zh: 起始重量要轻到每一次都能走同一条平稳的路线；等它变得轻松了，再小步增加重量或次数。

text.en: Light and heavy loads both build muscle when the sets are hard; heavier loads build more maximal strength.
text.zh: 只要每组都练得够吃力，轻重量和大重量都能增肌；大重量更能提高最大力量。

text.en: Spreading chest work over more than one day a week tends to work better than one big session.
text.zh: 把胸部训练分散到一周里不止一天，通常比一次练完效果好。

cautions.en: Keep fingers clear of pulleys and the weight stack; never let the handles snap back.
cautions.zh: 手指远离滑轮和配重片；不要让把手猛地弹回。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。
